astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: PanSTARRS and Planets
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Near the eastern horizon before sunrise, Comet C/2025 R3 PanSTARRS is getting brighter. Readily visible in binoculars and small telescopes, the comet may be just on the verge of naked-eye visibility from dark sky sites.
